knowability.hint: Dated facts about each register — who may see beneficial owners there and what OpenCheck reads of it. Describes, never judges: an absent owner is read against these, and none of them is a risk signal.

integrated_ownership.description: How much of the company each party holds, directly and through the companies it holds: shares are multiplied along each path and added across paths, and a company's own shares are given back to its other holders. Each source is computed on its own; figures from two sources are listed side by side, never added. Shareholdings only — voting rights, roles and control are not shares. For a person it is arithmetic on what was filed, not a determination of beneficial ownership. Context, not a finding.
integrated_ownership.credit: Method: integrated ownership as published by T-Rank (https://docs.trank.no/white_papers).
integrated_ownership.hint: Context, not a risk finding: no threshold is applied and none of these figures feeds the risk signals or the verdict. Each source is computed on its own; two figures for one party are two publishers' readings, never to be added.

listing.hint: The primary listing according to PermID: one main quote. Other listings of the same company are not shown. A venue URL is a listing or search page, not a filings page.
